name: ESO 269-66 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 269-66, a dwarf elliptical galaxy in the Centaurus A group, seen by Hubble.
label: eso26966-hubble
story: A quiet dwarf galaxy dominated by old stars, with a younger generation gathered more tightly toward its center. Hubble observed it to measure its distance and help weigh the dark halo around the giant galaxy Centaurus A.

claims.text: ESO 269-66 is a dwarf elliptical galaxy dominated by an old population
It is an early-type dwarf in the Centaurus A group
Its intermediate-age stars are more centrally concentrated than its old stars
Program 10235 targeted E269-66, a dwarf elliptical, to measure TRGB distances and constrain the halo around Cen A
